evaluation_mode: real deterministic engines with synthetic known answers and controlled model/tool fixtures

prohibited: model-created facts, values, tools or actions

matrix.expected: all requested metrics present or visible abstention
coverage and sufficiency reduced; incompatible evidence discarded
safe status and no diagnostic secret in rendered output
rendered claims map to the current typed ledger

confirmed_corrections: Negated domains no longer launch unrelated optional tools.
Staff-count and workforce-size paraphrases map to current active headcount.
Observed attrition percentage requests use deterministic observed evidence without requiring predictive scores.
Named-group and exclusion requests cannot report complete when typed filters are unavailable.
Regrettable attrition explicitly abstains because no registered tool measures it.
Individual disclosure, ranking and consequential-action requests stop before tools run.
Raw exception details are retained for diagnosis but omitted from user-facing warnings and answers.
A policy-blocked synthesis cannot reintroduce an unsafe evidence label through its deterministic fallback.
open_launch_gaps: No actual installed LLM has been evaluated for selection accuracy, injection resistance, latency or availability.
Tool execution is synchronous and has no enforced wall-clock deadline; timeout handling is validated only when a tool reports or raises a timeout.
Named subgroup, comparison and historical time filters are not typed agent capabilities.
The planner is deterministic lexical routing and cannot guarantee coverage of every natural-language paraphrase.
Investigation sessions preserve provenance but do not provide validated multi-turn conversational reference resolution.
Only seven governed aggregate tools are exposed; other product engines remain available through their dedicated APIs and renderers rather than the agent.
